name: Conform Magic Item (Item Mastery)
body:
You can make any magic item fit you, regardless of its size.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you activate a magic item, the item’s size changes to the size appropriate to you. If the item is then activated by someone else, it reverts back to its original size.
